reasons.plausibility: The proposed interface-mediated dislocation mechanism aligns well with known physics of nanoscale multilayers and HEAs, making it scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: Clearly defined sample sets with varying interface structures and direct TEM-based observation under sustained load provide a decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses how interfacial design might control creep in HEA multilayers, offering a practical strategy to guide research.
